We need to determine charges based on facts.

Facts: In static: Zhang blocked construction, got hit, his son Li was slapped by Wang. Wang ordered workers to beat Li, causing light injury (一级轻伤). Then Wang, to evade law, instructed Ren to make false testimony (伪证) about the assault, promising 10k per month. Also Wang instructed workers Wang Jia, Han to go to police station to make false testimony that Ren injured Li. So Ren was detained for suspected false testimony.

But we need to use official charge label as in Chinese criminal law: "伪证罪" (false testimony). The label in examples often omit "罪". For example, they gave "诈骗" not "诈骗罪".
